generations.prompt: Create an art-direction comparison board for a SIDE-ON 2D pixel-art metroidvania, two large 16:9 landscape frames stacked vertically, separated by a narrow black gutter, no text, no labels, no UI. Reference 1 teaches coherent spatial enclosure, focal hierarchy and restrained pixel detail, DO NOT copy its shrine or layout. Reference 2 is the ACTUAL 32px terrain material: muted olive moss on cool midnight blue soil, narrow bright edges, quiet interior. Reference 3 gives the scale and drawing of the 44-world-pixel orange hooded hero. Fine authored pixel clusters, hard nearest edges, restrained palette; no painterly brushwork, 3D rendering or isometric floor planes. Both frames depict the same place: an abandoned water-channel crossing at the edge of a windswept orchard at blue dusk. This is an OUTDOOR structure, sky visible through large openings. Use ONE continuous ancient sluice/aqueduct ruin as the spatial skeleton: massive masonry visibly joined to terrain, eroded grassy banks, a still dark channel, a small warm mechanical bell alcove as the single focal destination, and distant low orchard silhouettes. No complete freestanding house, no giant tree arch, no giant root patch, no distant clocktower. Design WHOLE connected place rather than a row of complete props. The orange hero must be small, ~6% of frame height, with readable silhouette on an accessible bank, never centered as a poster portrait. Ground and traversable edges read as thin olive lit contours on quiet dark material. Distant structures and surface marks subordinate. Spacious but shaped negative space. Local water reflections, subtle partial foreground framing belongs to structure. No sparkling ornaments everywhere, no uniform detail density. Top frame A: camera under a broken aqueduct, large partial cropped pier at left, one continuous elevated aqueduct body crossing upper frame then breaking to open sky at right; stepped lower banks across a narrow channel, warm alcove right of center. Bottom frame B: camera beside a broad eroded sluice retaining wall, strong asymmetric diagonal silhouette stepping down from upper left toward low right bank; a tall water gate opening at right frames the small warm bell chamber deeper behind, expansive cool sky and dark orchard distance at upper right, low channel across foreground. A and B must differ in overall mass and empty-space silhouette, not simply move props. Prioritize beautiful coherent complete game frames and material family, not complex item inventory. High resolution board, each frame composed as real horizontal gameplay camera view.
